etymology_text:
From Old Ruthenian Украина (Ukraina), Вкраина (Vkraina) from украина (ukraina), вкраина (vkraina), украйна (ukrajna, “borderland, land”), from Old East Slavic оукраина f (ukraina, “borderland, boundary”), from Proto-Slavic *ukrajina.
Can also be analysed as у (u) + край (kraj) + -ина (-yna). Doublet of Юкре́йн (Jukréjn).
